title: Proud Graduate and Grandfather at College, 1966 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A radiant young female graduate stands beside an elderly man, likely her grandfather or father, outdoors on a university campus with prominent Romanesque Revival brick arches in the background reminiscent of UCLA's Royce Hall. The smiling graduate wears a traditional cap and gown accessorized with a corsage and necklace, while her companion wears dark-rimmed spectacles, a bowtie, suit, and overcoat. Captured in February 1966, this portrait reflects the proud milestone of academic achievement and the growing presence of women in American higher education during the mid-1960s.
